title: rhodiola atropurpurea
intro: Rhodiola atropurpurea, commonly known as Arctic root, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Crassulaceae family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its adaptogenic properties, which help the body to adapt to stress, promoting overall well-being and enhancing physical and mental performance. The health benefits of Rhodiola atropurpurea include reducing fatigue, anxiety, and depression, as well as improving sleep quality and immune function. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-stress properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including rosmarinic acid, salidroside, and tyrosol.
